title: ParliamentRAG verifiable answer, version 1
description: An answer about the Italian Parliament written so that anyone can check it against the open data. Every quote is a claim: who said it, in which speech, for which group, with the link to the record. Field names are in English so the format works for any system.

system.description: The system that wrote the answer.

data_version.description: The data the answering system used: a release of the dataset emeierkeio/parliamentrag-leg19 (tag or commit on Hugging Face) or the date of the data (YYYY-MM-DD). A report made on a different version says so.

declared_absent.description: Groups the answer leaves out on purpose, with the reason. Checked from version 1 of the groups control, not by the quotes control.

text.description: The answer as the reader sees it. Optional: the verifier checks the claims.

speech.description: speech_id of the dataset (never a chunk id). Chamber: leg19_sed15_tit00070.sub00020.int00020. Senate: sen_leg19_sed321_p16725_deb0_5.

person.description: Official URI of the person (dati.camera.it or dati.senato.it). Government members without a seat: the dataset id (gov_surname_name).

group.description: Official URI of the parliamentary group (dati.camera.it gruppoParlamentare, dati.senato.it gruppo). For a member of a Misto component, the URI of the component, not of the whole Misto.

claim.description: One quote. The speaker either speaks for a group (group) or for the Government (government: true).

government.description: True when the speaker is quoted as a member of the Government.

quote.description: The quoted words, as shown to the reader, without the quotation marks.

link.description: Link to the official record of the sitting.
